name: Jes'rimon's Payment to Jediga
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Take this letter to Jediga. Let her know that our deal has been beneficial and I be pleased with her work.

You tell her she come back to Orgrimmar fast and Jes'rimon make sure he take good care of her.

Tell her that, and maybe in the future I have need of your services again, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I can see he was more than pleased by the looks of his note.... a little too pleased.

Perhaps some day I'll take time to make sure he knows how much I appreciate his advances also. Well, at least there's one reason to look forward to spending more time in Azshara.

Here's your share of our payment.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Have you spoken to Jes'rimon yet?

He's a boar among trolls, but his information is usually accurate and his jobs well paying.

If you can stand his attitude then you stand to make some good coin from his business endeavors.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 52, 11,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Stealing Knowledge
quests.objectiveText: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Jes'rimon's Payment to Jediga
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
